hexanal.value_provenance_note: 2026-08-27 (Wave I, cold-start red-team finding): this value is NOT an independently measured concentration in this repo's chain of custody. The arithmetic is exact: OAV 280 (the value the intake registry records for this anchor, 'Defined raw-pea hexanal baseline: 1260 ug/kg (OAV ~280)') x 4.5 ppb, where 4.5 ppb is THIS REPO'S OWN hexanal odour-detection threshold -- itself a compilation-level number that has never been read off a primary table (see the hexanal ODT anchor's harmonization_note in this file; published aqueous hexanal ODTs span 0.3-14 ug/L). 280 x 4.5 = 1260.0 to the digit. It is therefore possible that the source reports 1260 ug/kg directly and the OAV is the derived quantity -- but that has NOT been confirmed against the paper, and the exact divisibility by our own unsourced constant is precisely why the two readings cannot be told apart from inside the repo. Scored as a hold-out point it is a consistency check against our own threshold, not an external measurement, and it MOVES if that threshold is ever corrected.
